chunks: “Whoever says, when he has performed the Maghrib prayer, three times: ‘All praise belongs to Allah, Who
and none other than Him does whatever he wills,’ he will be given abundant good.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith

ai.seo_question: What should be recited after Maghrib prayer for abundant goodness?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a post-salat remembrance to be recited after Maghrib three times. It praises Allah’s absolute will and power, and promises abundant goodness for the one who recites it.
